threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'takeaway' instead of a 'chippy'. Locals know it’s all about the fish and chips on Saturday by the Kingsland Road.
Last night on the 59, a guy insisted he could read tarot cards with just a Snickers wrapper. He gave everyone a fortune, mostly about the weather.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy juggling flaming torches while waiting for the bus at Sonnenallee. Totally normal for a Tuesday evening!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find ‘Kiez’ pranks where locals sneak random items into public art pieces, just to watch tourists puzzled by the additions.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You see someone tip their barista in pesos—definite local. If they say ‘Civic Center’ like ‘Civ-ic Senter’, they’re probably just in town for work.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in flip-flops catch a Muni bus by jumping off a skateboard. Just another day in the Outer Sunset, where the unexpected is the norm.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think all the tapas are the same. But true locals know that the real gems are those hidden bars with family recipes passed down for generations.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them still trying to pay with cash in cafes where it's card only. Classic rookie move, like tourists at the Sagrada!

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'bus stop' instead of a 'bus shelter'—everyone knows that's where the drama unfolds.
Caught the N63 last night; a guy in full suit was singing opera to a bemused crowd. Only in Brixton, right? The bus felt like a stage.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the U-Bahn was shut down for days, but I still heard a saxophonist jamming near the station. That's when I felt the true spirit of Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find techno clubs tucked inside former wedding halls, where the bass thumps louder than the vows ever did.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to avoid the BART at rush hour after overheated brakes. Tourists look puzzled while we swap stories about delays like it's normal.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing the accordion on the 30 Stockton this morning, completely drowned out by a toddler's tantrum. Classic San Francisco chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just for partying; they miss the real treasure—those tiny art studios hidden behind unmarked doors.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their aversion to the 'hola' with eye contact; locals know it’s all about the nod while walking by.
